screen.isekai_mahou.perf.preset.low.desc: For laptops or integrated graphics (Intel UHD/Iris, Vega). Few particles, distance 6, fast graphics, no shadows or clouds. As light as possible without ruining the spells.
screen.isekai_mahou.perf.preset.ok.desc: Average PC. Reduced particles, distance 8, fast graphics, simple clouds. A good balance between looks and FPS.
screen.isekai_mahou.perf.preset.good.des: Dedicated graphics card. Full effects, distance 12, fancy graphics, shadows and clouds.
screen.isekai_mahou.perf.preset.ultra.de: Strong PC. Mod effects maxed out (more particles, glow and range), distance 16, smooth biome blend.
